# Mars Harness Skills v5

Eight portable skills turn SaaS-style workflows into a staged mission process. Five specialist packs emulate research, engineering, collaboration, and project-delivery applications; three control packs orchestrate, validate, and remember.

Recommended sequence: `mars-harness-orchestrator` → appropriate specialist skill(s) → `ground-truth-gatekeeper` → `pm-accelerator-harness` → `mission-memory-steward`.

Each skill is a procedure, not a claim of native platform equivalence. Install or adapt the folder according to the target runtime, map tools explicitly, and preserve approval boundaries.
